conviction_note: Nothing found that the price is missing. This is the first quarterly report of a holding company set up on 2026-06-01. Q1 (Jun-Aug) is the seasonal low of its larger half. The 10-month plan was set on 2026-07-14 and sits close to the pro-forma run-rate. Shareholder returns are explicitly deferred to the May 2027 mid-term plan, so the findings net to about +0.05 with p_up 50. abs_move is set at 2.5%, well below the 17% proxy, because that 17% was the July forecast/優待 announcement, not a quarterly print.
bar: Company 10-month plan (2026-06-01 to 2027-03-31): sales 55,000m, OP 6,600m, ordinary 7,100m, net 19,200m including a provisional 14,500m negative-goodwill gain (net ex-gain 4,600m), dividend 63 yen year-end only. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593251.pdf (also https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/575A0/140120260714593251.pdf). No 四季報 or IFIS consensus is reachable: kabuyoho's consensus is blank at https://kabuyoho.jp/sp/reportAnalyst?bcode=575A. The bar is therefore company-only, and every size is capped small.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% with no disclosed seller, unchanged (as of 2026-09-29, baseline). kabutan margin data (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=575A, 10/02): margin short 1.4k shares, margin long 171.5k shares, 信用倍率 122. That 122 is STRUCTURAL, not crowding. kabutan flags 575A as a 制度信用 name that can only be bought on margin (買建のみ, not 貸借), so the margin short side cannot build. The long balance is about 0.45% of 38.25m issued shares, roughly two days of turnover. The baseline's margin_overhang component (-1.04) therefore probably overstates leveraged-long overhang. No option skew exists. Run-up: +2.49% over 20 days, +2.98% over 5 days.

findings.finding: Q1 (Jun-Aug) is the seasonal trough of 前澤工業, the larger half and the accounting acquirer. Its Jun-Aug quarters were OP -1.34億 (FY25/5) and -0.87億 on 60.4億 sales (FY26/5), and it lost money at the OP line in each of the last four Q1s. 前澤化成 runs about 6億 OP a quarter. So consolidated Q1 OP should land near 4-6億, only about 6-9% of the 66億 plan, while reported net carries the about 145億 negative-goodwill gain (about 77% of the 192億 net plan).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No quarterly print exists for 575A. The only event in the baseline is +17.0% on 2026-07-15, the forecast and 優待 introduction, not a quarterly result. 6489.T's own Q1 reactions are unreachable because Yahoo returns 'delisted'.
findings.source_date: 2026-05-27 (page snapshot; quarterly figures from 前澤工業 短信 through FY26/5 Q3, Q1 FY26/5 released 2025-10-15)
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Anyone can compute the seasonality from the predecessors' last 短信, so LESSONS rule 1 applies. The only unpriced part is how a retail register new to this holding company reads a low OP progress rate next to a headline net-profit progress rate near 77%. If the market were worried about Q1 progress, the stock would have faded into the print; instead it is up 2.5% over 20 days and near its 52-week high of 1,993.
findings.independence: Kabutan 6489 quarterly table (https://kabutan.jp/stock/finance?code=6489) shows the same Jun-Aug figures (24.06-08 OP -134m, 25.06-08 OP -87m). Same underlying 短信, so this is not independent.

findings.finding: 前澤工業's last stand-alone year beat its own plan: FY26/5 OP 5,476m against a 4,900m plan (+12%), orders 41,432m against sales 39,920m. Rebuilding Jun-Mar from the predecessors' quarterly run-rates gives about 65-68億 of OP before holding-company costs, so the 66億 10-month plan looks achievable and is likely held at Q1 rather than cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The one guidance event, the first 10-month forecast with 優待 on 2026-07-14, moved +17.0% the next session (baseline). No revision history exists for 575A.
findings.why_not_priced: This was public on 2026-07-14, so the plan's credibility is largely in the price. The residual is that no consensus exists to anchor it: if the street doubted the plan, the post-July level of about 1,790-1,950 would have faded, and it has not.
findings.independence: The plan document with the pro-forma comparison (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260714/140120260714593251.pdf) and the kabutan/Fisco note that the combined prior-year OP was about 78億 for 12 months (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=575A&b=n202607150783). These are different documents, but the second partly restates the first.

findings.finding: The 14,500m negative-goodwill gain is booked in Q1 and is explicitly provisional (暫定的に算定), to be confirmed in closing. Its finalisation at this print could move the 192億 net forecast, but the company has said the gain is non-cash and excluded from the dividend base.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance for this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Little is left to price. The item sits below operating income with no path to the dividend or the OP guide, so any change moves only reported net and PER optics (PER 3.8 on kabutan).

findings.finding: Shareholder returns beyond the 63 yen year-end dividend are explicitly deferred to the new mid-term plan due in mid-May 2027, so the release is unlikely to carry a buyback or a policy change. The 優待 (Niigata rice for 500+ shares, record date 2026-11-30 this year) keeps retail holders in through the window.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 優待 introduction on 2026-07-14 was part of the +17.0% move on 2026-07-15.
findings.why_not_priced: Already public. It matters here mainly as an absence: the most common large mover at a Japanese print, a returns announcement, is unlikely at this one. The upside tail covers a surprise buyback, which a PBR below 1 and a cash-rich 前澤化成 would allow.
findings.independence: kabutan 優待 article (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=575A&b=n202607141144) confirms the 2026-11-30 record date.

outside_window.finding: An upward revision of the 10-month plan, if 前澤工業's strong FY26/5 (OP +12% vs plan) and order backlog carry over, would most plausibly come with H1 or Q3 results. The new mid-term plan and return policy are due mid-May 2027.

Every 575A disclosure batch on 2026-07-14 was stamped 15:30, and predecessor 前澤工業 released its 短信 at 15:30 (2026-01-09, 2026-04-10). Sources: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=575A&nmode=3 and https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6489&nmode=3
bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: unlikely at Q1; the 10-month plan sits near the pro-forma run-rate; the only plausible change is the provisional negative-goodwill amount, which affects net only. Returns: deferred to the May 2027 mid-term plan; a buyback would be a surprise. New-year guide: not applicable at Q1. Quarter vs own 進捗率: there is no history for the holding; the predecessors' seasonality implies Q1 OP of about 6-9% of plan, which is normal for this business.
baseline_tension: The findings net to about zero, against a baseline lean of -1.17 that is driven mostly by a margin_overhang term. I read that term as an artefact of 575A being a buy-only margin name (no 貸借), which keeps margin shorts near zero and inflates 信用倍率. The strongest positive the release could carry is a held plan plus a buyback, which I looked for and which the company has deferred to May 2027. The strongest negative is a low OP progress rate that the predecessors' seasonality already shows.
lessons_applied: Rule 1, a negative on a progress rate anyone can compute from the last 短信: Q1-seasonality finding shrunk from -0.3 to -0.15; p_up was already 50.
Rule 2, check for the strongest positive: looked for a buyback or returns change and recorded in baseline_tension that it is deferred to May 2027. No size changed.
The open question on five-day run-ins was not applied; the +2.98% 5-day run-in was not sized as a short signal.
